prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1074; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Witnesses and the officer say the claimant was not in the vehicle when the crash happened.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: On arrival at the intersection in Pearland, Texas, I found a two-vehicle collision involving a vehicle that was turning left across the path of oncoming traffic. Driver 1 was operating the vehicle making the left turn, and Driver 2 was operating the other vehicle. Driver 1 reported a wrist fracture from the impact. The injury is consistent with the kind and force of this collision. Scene photographs confirm the positions of both vehicles and some of the reported details. The visible damage is largely in line with the impact described. No independent witnesses were located. Statements from Driver 2 and Passenger, along with my own observations, indicate that Driver 1 was not inside the vehicle when the collision occurred. No prior damage to the vehicle is known. Records show Driver 1 is named on the policy covering the vehicle. Further investigation of the statements is recommended before any findings are made.
